canonical_rerank_reason: rule: max hit@3, then max hit@1 (each within 0.02), then min p50. Tied on quality: faiss_rerank_minilm_l6, faiss_rerank_minilm_l6_fp16. Measured: faiss_rerank_minilm_l6: hit@1=0.96 hit@3=1.00 p50=156.7 ms; faiss_rerank_bge_base: hit@1=0.87 hit@3=0.96 p50=536.9 ms; faiss_rerank_minilm_l6_fp16: hit@1=0.96 hit@3=1.00 p50=65.9 ms; faiss_rerank_bge_base_fp16: hit@1=0.87 hit@3=0.96 p50=165.3 ms
canonical_note: remote_api is canonically the faiss backend behind HTTP on loopback; its compute matches the faiss profile, so its extra cost is pure transport. Replace with a WAN measurement once a deployment is approved.
